captures.command: cp -r public/docs/assets/fieldml_macro_demo <ws>/FieldMLMacroDemo && python3 tools/field_backdoor.py --workspace <ws> --with-playwright --command 'open FieldMLMacroDemo' --command 'run fieldml-macro-parameter' --command 'run fieldml-macro-drawing' --command 'screenshot-box fieldml-macro-drawing spiral.png' --command 'set fieldml-macro-parameter code --file <swirl 0.35 / turns 9 variant>' --command 'run fieldml-macro-parameter' --command 'run fieldml-macro-drawing' --command 'screenshot-box fieldml-macro-drawing spiral-edited.png'
captures.artifact: spiral.png and spiral-edited.png, joined side by side with a 16px black gutter. The pair is the *counterfactual*: the two captures must differ, and FieldMLSourceMacroTest.theDemoCapturesShowTheParameterActuallyChangingTheDrawing floors that at 5.0% of pixels with an ink guard on each. The docs runner cannot make these because they need a live Field driving a document across two edits of a shared box property.

captures.command: cp -r public/docs/assets/fieldml_frames_demo <ws>/FieldMLFramesDemo && python3 tools/field_backdoor.py --workspace <ws> --graphics-context --command 'open FieldMLFramesDemo' --command "run window and renderer" --command 'run <the FieldML box>' --command 'native-screenshot spin-0.png' --command 'sleep 1' --command 'native-screenshot spin-1.png' (and so on for 2 and 3)
captures.artifact: spin-0.png … spin-3.png, four captures a second apart, joined into spin-frames.png. Needs a real Vulkan device: the subject is a triangle spinning under a Frames loop, so consecutive frames must *differ* — measured up to 28.5% of pixels on 2026-08-19. An identical set of four means the per-frame body did not run.

captures.command: cp -r public/docs/assets/fieldml_mesh_demo <ws>/FieldMLMeshDemo && python3 tools/field_backdoor.py --workspace <ws> --graphics-context --command 'open FieldMLMeshDemo' --command "run window and renderer" --command 'run <the FieldML box>' --command 'native-screenshot ring-0.png' --command 'sleep 1' --command 'native-screenshot ring-1.png' (and so on for 2 and 3)
captures.artifact: ring-0.png … ring-3.png joined into ring-frames.png. Needs a real Vulkan device. The subject is a vertex shader with real inputs whose data FieldML rewrites every frame, so the hues must rotate between captures; a static ring means Mesh.write did not land.

captures.command: CHART_GALLERY_DIR=/tmp/chart_gallery python3 tools/run_field_tests.py --id visualization.chart-gallery && cp /tmp/chart_gallery/* public/docs/assets/chart_gallery/

captures.command: FUNCTIONS_PLOT_DIR=/tmp/functions_gallery python3 tools/run_field_tests.py --id functions.plot-gallery && cp /tmp/functions_gallery/* public/docs/assets/functions_gallery/
captures.artifact: Every plotted (x, y) is a real Fn.evalSafe(...) of a genuine Functions graph and the fit series is a real fitGradient run; only the line between real samples is synthetic. The mp4 is one fresh truncated fitGradient run per frame rather than a cached trajectory, and it is best-effort: a machine without ffmpeg prints a skip note instead of failing.
